Title: Successful User Login
Preconditions: User has valid account and is on login page
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter valid email in email field. 3. Enter valid password in password field. 4. Click the 'Login' button.

Title: Successful Admin Login
Preconditions: Admin has valid account and is on login page
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter valid admin email. 3. Enter valid admin password. 4. Click 'Login'.

Title: Login with Wrong Password
Preconditions: User has account and is on login page
Steps: 1. Enter valid email. 2. Enter incorrect password. 3. Click 'Login'.

Title: Login with Empty Fields
Steps: 1. Leave email and password fields empty. 2. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: Error messages for both fields: 'Email is required'

Title: Login with SQL Injection Attempt
Steps: 1. Enter email: ' OR '1'='1. 2. Enter password: anything. 3. Click 'Login'.

Title: Successful User Registration
Steps: 1. Enter unique username. 2. Enter valid email. 3. Enter password (min 8 chars). 4. Confirm password. 5. Click 'Register'.

Title: Registration with Existing Email
Steps: 1. Enter existing email. 2. Enter other details. 3. Click 'Register'.

Title: Registration with Weak Password
Steps: 1. Enter details with password <8 chars. 2. Click 'Register'.
Expected Result: Error: 'Password must be at least 8 characters'.

Title: Registration with Mismatched Passwords
Steps: 1. Enter password. 2. Enter different confirm password. 3. Click 'Register'.

Title: OTP Verification for Login
Preconditions: User enabled 2FA and is on OTP page
Steps: 1. Enter valid OTP from email/SMS. 2. Click 'Verify'.

Title: Session Timeout
Expected Result: 30 min). 2. Try to access protected page.

Title: Remember Me Login
Steps: 1. Close browser. 2. Reopen and go to site.

Title: Password Reset Request
Steps: 1. Click 'Forgot Password'. 2. Enter email. 3. Click 'Send Reset Link'.

Title: Password Reset with Valid Token
Steps: 1. Click link in email. 2. Enter new password. 3. Confirm. 4. Click 'Reset'.

Title: Account Lock After Failed Attempts
Steps: 1. Attempt login 5 times with wrong password.

Title: View Product Detail
Expected Result: Product detail page opens with full info.

Title: Product Search by Name
Steps: 1. Enter product name in search bar. 2. Click search.

Title: Filter by Category
Steps: 1. Select category from filter. 2. Click apply.

Title: Filter by Price Range
Steps: 1. Set min and max price. 2. Click apply.

Title: Sort by Price Low to High
Steps: 1. Select sort option 'Price: Low to High'.

Title: Pagination
Preconditions: User on product page with many products

Title: Out of Stock Product
Preconditions: User views out of stock product

Title: Product Share
Steps: 1. Click share button. 2. Select social media.

Title: Add Multiple Quantities
Steps: 1. Set quantity to 5. 2. Click 'Add to Cart'.

Title: Update Cart Quantity
Steps: 1. Change quantity of item. 2. Click update.

Title: Cart Persistence
Priority: 1. Add item. 2. Logout. 3. Login. 4. Check cart.

Title: Cart Limit Exceeded
Preconditions: User tries to add more than stock

Title: Invalid Address
Steps: 1. Leave required fields empty. 2. Click next.

Title: Guest Checkout
Steps: 1. Add to cart. 2. Checkout as guest.

Title: Checkout Validation
Steps: 1. Try to place order without address.

Title: Change Password
Steps: 1. Enter current and new password. 2. Save.

Title: Profile Email Verification
Steps: 1. Enter new email. 2. Verify via link.

Title: Add Review
Steps: 1. Click 'Write Review'. 2. Rate and comment. 3. Submit.
